# Security Policy

mobile-report is an academic documentation and evidence repository. Do not
publish credentials, tokens, private interview material or sensitive evidence in
issues, pull requests, commits or screenshots.

Runtime, application and infrastructure vulnerabilities belong in the
corresponding Nexa product repository. For a sensitive concern specific to this
repository, use GitHub private security reporting when it is available rather
than a public issue.

This repository does not provide a production support or response-time
commitment.
